name: elastic-mesh

frames.best_why: The whole word is inflated and glossy with clean highlights, centred with even space and no cursor over a letter.

tagline: Glossy blue letters inflate like balloons and wobble when poked.
summary: A word turned into a puffy, shiny blue solid that looks like inflated rubber. The letters spring in on load, lean toward the pointer, and dent and stretch when pressed or dragged.
appearance: A fat rounded word in deep royal blue sits centred on pure black, each letter shaped like a filled balloon with bright white streaks across the top. Soft shading rounds the tubes and a faint dark shadow grounds them.
behaviour: Letters arrive one after another with a bouncy overshoot, then rest. The surface tips gently toward the pointer; holding presses a dent into the rubber and dragging stretches the shape around the grab point before it springs back.
demo_content: The word "Boing" with the caption "Press, poke and stretch".
use_when: A playful logo or short word as the centrepiece of a promo, game or brand page.
avoid_when: Only a word or two fits, it needs a sized parent, and the WebGL simulation costs GPU time.
customise: Set the word with text or an image with src, then choose colour, material, inflate, stiffness, wobble, stretch, press and shadow. Font family, weight, theme and intro are also props.
weight_why: A springy node mesh solved in 480 Hz substeps plus full-screen shaders every frame.

a11y.note: The canvas is exposed as an image labelled with the word; reduced motion skips the intro and pointer tilt.

issues: The word spans nearly the full width, leaving the last letter tight against the frame edge.
polish_why: Convincing inflated material and highlights; the layout leaves almost no margin around the word.
title: Elastic Mesh
